stops.name: parco Oglio Nord
stops.detail: The park Oglio Nord is a river park of the Lombardy region established on 16 April 1988 with L.R. n° 18, which develops along the auction of the river Oglio in the stretch between the exit from Lake Iseo and the municipalities of Seniga, left bank, and Gabbioneta-Binanuova, right bank. The section between Seniga-Gabbioneta Binanuova and the mouth is protected by the Parco Oglio Sud.
